description: Record, replay and analyse AI agent runs; turn failures into eval cases

milestones.title: Week 1: Demo agent and foundations
milestones.description: Repo tooling and a provider-switchable LangGraph issue triager that produces runs to record.

milestones.title: Week 2: Recorder core
milestones.description: Ingest Claude Code and OTel runs, redact, store in Postgres + pgvector, list and replay from the CLI.

milestones.title: Week 3: Evals and guardrails
milestones.description: Error analysis on real runs, own eval harness, golden cases, LLM judge, red-team set, evals gating CI.

milestones.title: Week 4: Analyst, MCP and deploy
milestones.description: Analyst agent turns failures into eval cases; MCP server; deployed to Cloud Run + Cloud SQL with Terraform.

milestones.title: Week 5: Replay UI and launch
milestones.description: React replay UI, five-minute quickstart, README, demo and going public.
